authority.scope: Read-only cross-check of GTK2 normal horizontal scrollbar arrows against existing original-VM study evidence.

I295 live source capture provenance and limits

reference.source_vm: User-owned original VM; only existing read-only study captures were inspected in this step.
reference.gtk_runtime: GTK2 2.24.33 isolated native preview captured in R233

original_vm_capture.note: Original-VM capture with the pointer over the vertical upper arrow; both horizontal cells are unobstructed.

method.scale: 1:1 RGB; no resizing, interpolation, color normalization or masking

results.interpretation: In the normal state, both horizontal GTK2 stepper cells in the isolated preview match the same 15x15 pixels visible in the existing original-VM capture. The report that these normal arrows are narrower is not reproduced in this GTK2 preview. No geometry change is supported by this comparison.

limits: This verifies only the normal left/right cells in the isolated GTK2 preview and the existing original-VM screenshot.
The I295 source study provides held/released transition pairs for vertical arrows only; horizontal held-state behavior remains unmeasured historically.
This does not prove the GTK2 theme revision currently loaded by any user application; R306/R307 found an older installed copy.
The canonical assistant VM live view remains separately unresolved; no input was sent in this cross-check.
This is technical evidence, not user visual approval or full GTK2 fidelity.

technical_coverage_estimate.basis: No new distinct control state was completed; this cross-check corroborates the existing normal horizontal-arrow comparison across an additional original-VM source capture.
